summary: Rebrand regression sweep for Obserra Cyber Crisis Commander. Backend smoke passes (PDF 200 %PDF, assurance-digest/preview 200 JSON). All sidebar routes load without crash. Onboarding tour title now 'Welcome to Obserra Cyber Crisis Commander' and 'Start at Control Posture' step targets data-testid nav-control-posture (which resolves). Executive Overview shows 'CYBER CRISIS COMMANDER ROLLUP' badge and 'whole Cyber Crisis Commander estate' body text. Control Posture nav item routes to /app/control-intelligence with heading 'Control Posture Mission Control'. Cyber Crisis Commander page: with Demo Mode enabled all 4 tabs render — Mission Control (Mission Control — Active Crisis Command + Response Action Status + Control Failure Intelligence), Decision Room (Decision Room — Executive Approval Queue + crisis-sla-scan-btn present), Containment & Recovery (Identity Containment panel present), War Room (Identity Protection + crisis-risky-users testid present). Demo mode was toggled off afterward. ONE regression miss found: static HTML head in frontend/public/index.html still contains 'Control Intelligence' in the <title> and meta description — the browser tab title on every page reads 'Obserra — Control Intelligence'. This is user-visible UI (tab title) and violates the 'no Control Intelligence anywhere in the UI' requirement.

ui_bugs.issue: Browser tab <title> still reads 'Obserra — Control Intelligence' and meta[name=description] still contains 'Obserra — Control Intelligence.' — rebrand miss, visible in every browser tab. Should be 'Obserra — Cyber Crisis Commander'.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> rendered as child of <select><option> (SystemHealth.jsx around line 1075). Not a rebrand bug — pre-existing DOM validity warning worth cleaning.

rca of the issue: During the broad rebrand from 'Control Intelligence' to 'Cyber Crisis Commander' the static index.html <title> and description meta tags were not updated. These render as the browser tab title on every route, so the regression is user-visible even though no React component text was missed. Fix: edit frontend/public/index.html lines 44 and 61 to replace 'Control Intelligence' with 'Cyber Crisis Commander'.
